_comment: Every scenario's declared expectation, in one reviewable place. The tests
read this file rather than hard-coding numbers, so a corpus's intent and
the assertion made about it cannot drift apart.
as_filename matters: compact_markdown_file only renumbers tags for
learnings.md and user_choices.md, and only it reads utf-8-sig. The runner
copies each corpus to a correctly-named temp file before compacting.
expect applies to every arm; expect_by_embedder carries what differs
between them. Both quality AND savings are declared everywhere: recall
alone is maximized by not compacting, savings alone by deleting
everything, and only the pair is a claim worth making.
The noop arm is compact_command.NoOpEmbedder, the production
everything-is-unique class. It is the literal what-if-we-did-not-merge
control that makes the other arms' numbers interpretable.
lane says what a scenario is for. conservation scenarios cannot lose
anything offline and assert recall of exactly 1.0. lossy scenarios are the
two places offline compaction genuinely destroys information - pruning and
silently dropped malformed input - and they assert the exact records and
keywords that were lost, not a tolerance band.
expected_source_records counts every '## '-led block the file visibly
contains; expected_parsed_records counts what parse_episodic_md actually
ingests. They differ only in S7, and the difference is the point: a block
can be DROPPED (invalid header between genuine records) or FOLDED into the
record above it (invalid header after the last genuine one). Deriving one
from the other would hide the second case.

scenarios.hypothesis: verbatim duplicates collapse with zero information loss
notes: No rare keywords exist by construction: every sentence appears three
times, so none occurs in exactly one. rare_recall is reported as null,
not as a fictitious 1.0.
The noop arm is the control - refusing to merge turns a real saving
into a loss, which is exactly the cost of the metadata markers.

scenarios.hypothesis: paraphrases of one symptom merge without losing a distinct fact
notes: Recall must be 1.0 under BOTH arms: the offline merge is a verbatim
join, so anything below 1.0 here is a defect rather than a quality
trade-off. The finding is the merge yield between the arms.

scenarios.hypothesis: nothing merges, so compaction only adds metadata overhead
notes: The file gets BIGGER. Asserting that sign is the strongest guard
available against a regression that deletes records to look efficient,
and it is Bugs.md #52 expressed as a measured number.

scenarios.hypothesis: a statement and its negation are never folded into one memory
notes: Six asymmetric pairs stay apart. The seventh is a CONTROL: both halves
carry a negation marker, so the guard - which tests marker ASYMMETRY -
does not fire, and they merge. That is the guard's blind spot, asserted
as real behaviour rather than hidden behind an xfail.

scenarios.hypothesis: pruning drops the bottom of the ranking, and some of it survives nowhere else
notes: The only scenario where pruning actually fires. The gate is
sum(len(m.content)) >= MIN_PRUNE_BUDGET on POST-MERGE content
characters, which is the likeliest way a pruning scenario quietly does
nothing - so pruning_applied is asserted explicitly rather than assumed
from the config.
The headline is prune_collateral, not a recall-versus-fraction curve.
Pruning drops floor(n x fraction) records BY RANK, so a curve over the
fraction is a step function fully determined by the importance ordering:
it measures whether we deleted what we said we would, not quality.
Collateral separates a good prune (the facts live on elsewhere) from a
bad one (they existed only there).
type_recall_min is a loose guard against a regression that suddenly
destroys far more; the EXACT assertions are the pruned tags and counts.

scenarios.hypothesis: the user_choices shape round-trips with explicit provenance intact
notes: Tags are renumbered to 'User Choice N' on the first pass, so recall
must stay 1.0 - a tag is not content, and renumbering must cost
exactly zero keywords.

scenarios.hypothesis: malformed input is dropped silently, and only the raw denominator can see it
notes: Three different fates, decided purely by position, all measured here.
DROPPED: T-702 has an unparseable timestamp and sits BETWEEN two
genuine records, so it is discarded with no error. Its keywords are the
exact loss this scenario reports.
FOLDED: the trailing '## Appendix on retention' is not a valid header
but follows the last genuine record, so it is appended to that record's
body. Nothing is lost.
PHANTOM: the '## <valid timestamp> - EXAMPLE' line lives inside a
fenced code block, but the block split is textual rather than
markdown-aware, so a documentation example is promoted into a real
memory record. No content is lost, but a record is invented.
The file also carries a leading BOM, which is why the runner goes
through compact_markdown_file - only the file API reads utf-8-sig, and
a BOM read as plain utf-8 costs the first record outright.
denominator is raw, and that is the entire point: scored on parsed,
this corpus reports a flawless 1.0 while having silently lost a record,
because the dropped record leaves the denominator along with the
numerator.

scenarios.hypothesis: repeated compaction reaches a fixed point instead of eroding
notes: Recall is measured against GENERATION ZERO every time, never against
the previous generation: erosion of two percent per pass looks harmless
next to its predecessor and ruinous next to the source.
The fixed point exists only because build_durable_memories honours a
prior pass's '<!-- id: -->' marker. Without it a singleton's id would
drift on every recompaction - compact_markdown_file renames tags on the
first pass, and _record_id is sensitive to the tag. Nothing else in the
suite guards that end to end.

scenarios.hypothesis: a shared auto-failure prefix does not pull unrelated failures together
notes: Every record shares the exact prefix artifacts.run_shared_command()
writes. _embedding_text strips it before embedding; with the prefix
left in, max pairwise cosine is 0.625 and these eight unrelated
failures WOULD merge at the 0.60 threshold. The corpus is calibrated
so that strip is load-bearing.
